knowledge.applied_rule: Keep one bounded installation, preserve consumed budget and explicitly separate source installation from post-installation proof; use latest explicit owner authority only for round 2.

Use deterministic regressions for reporting defects, actual pinned dependency validation before publication, and actual target-environment evidence after installation; mocks cannot establish live behavior.

coverage.assessment: Inspected reporter: all three verdicts must PASS and all three finding lists are checked. Tests cover missing/HOLD/FAIL and synthesis-owned material findings. Owner report distinguishes usefulness, required CI and absence of independent assurance.

Gate checks timestamp boundary, exact checkout identities, one packet, complete sidecars, exact changed inventory, current base, immutable source pins and ready checker result. Eight deterministic routing fixtures pass. Actual shared code already reproduced exact old candidate and rejected stale evidence; final full current-candidate validation remains a mandatory next gate. Live trigger is explicitly a post-merge dependency, not claimed passed.

Inspected workflow and gate: read-only contents permissions, base scripts, exact candidate data checkout, no persisted credentials, pinned shared source and no candidate application execution. No hard branch enforcement is claimed.

Round 1 packet/reports/contract/QA retained byte-for-byte. Round 2 uses a PR432-scoped adapter, leaving default max_rounds=1 and all pins unchanged. Changes confined to installation governance/evidence. Owner-stopped acquisition and concurrent PRs/lanes untouched.

findings.evidence: Historical reporter allowed reviewed status despite Supporter/Critic HOLD. Current code requires every verdict PASS.
Historical reporter omitted synthesis-owned material findings. Current reporter includes synthesis in its reports array and corresponding regression passes.

scope_limit: Constructive same-chat source-installation review only. Does not establish final pinned validation, exact-head CI, merge, live activation or hard branch enforcement.
